Счётчики активных AI/IMC runs для company-only Job Center (один round-trip).

poll_after_ms.title: Poll After Ms
poll_after_ms.description: Интервал опроса UI (мс), если в списке есть незавершённые запуски; 0 если все терминальны.

recent_runs_digest.title: Recent Runs Digest
recent_runs_digest.description: Последние завершённые запуски AMKA по проекту (кратко, для UI/памяти).

recent_runs_digest_markdown.title: Recent Runs Digest Markdown
recent_runs_digest_markdown.description: Тот же дайджест в markdown для read-only блока в кабинете.

user_instruction.title: User Instruction
user_instruction.description: Optional operator note about emphasis or constraints for the audit.

section_keys.title: Section Keys
section_keys.description: Optional subset of cabinet sections; transitive dependencies are added server-side.

imc_type_key.title: Imc Type Key
imc_type_key.description: Default IMC research type_key when the plan does not override it.

imc_max_wait_seconds.title: Imc Max Wait Seconds
imc_max_wait_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for IMC terminal status during execute_section (capped by server settings).

run_mode.title: Run Mode
run_mode.description: semi_auto: await plan approval. auto: start execution immediately after planning.

per_step_execution.title: Per Step Execution
per_step_execution.description: When true (semi_auto only), pause after each execute_section until POST continue-step.

auto_cycle_count.title: Auto Cycle Count
auto_cycle_count.description: Number of full AMKA runs in a row when run_mode=auto (ignored for semi_auto).

preset_id.title: Preset Id
preset_id.description: UUID пресета проекта; дополнительные задачи плана подмешиваются при планировании.

use_web_search.title: Use Web Search
use_web_search.description: Legacy flag; when true and web_search_quality omitted, treated as standard.

web_search_quality.title: Web Search Quality
web_search_quality.description: Web search depth for AMKA IMC steps: off | light | standard | deep.

pulse.title: Pulse
pulse.description: Human-facing AMKA pulse: changes, preserved state, doubts, agreements, and no-op reason.

standalone_projection.title: Standalone Projection
standalone_projection.description: Read-only projection of the marketing run through the standalone AMKA driver boundary.

traces.title: Traces
traces.description: Normalized AmkaCoreEngine trace timeline (stage, event, message, payload).

AmkaCoreAlignmentOut.title: AmkaCoreAlignmentOut
AmkaCoreAlignmentOut.description: Read-only AmkaCoreEngine alignment for an existing run (persisted plan, no act()).

readiness_meta.description: Расшифровка формулы готовности: веса, вклад баллов, метаданные среднего по coverage.

MarketingProjectDashboardResponse.description: Health + overview в одном ответе (все поля обоих).

active_ai_run_id.title: Active Ai Run Id
active_ai_run_id.description: Active marketing_ai_runs id for UI poll resume when status=processing

plan_llm_status.description: Статус разбора LLM master plan: ok, empty, parse_error, error, disabled, not_applicable, heuristic_fallback.

plan_used_llm_tasks.title: Plan Used Llm Tasks
plan_used_llm_tasks.description: True, если итоговые задачи плана взяты из нормализованного ответа LLM (не откат на кандидатов).

plan_structure_errors.title: Plan Structure Errors
plan_structure_errors.description: Краткие коды ошибок структуры ответа LLM master plan (до нормализации).

MarketingChatSseProgressOut.title: MarketingChatSseProgressOut
MarketingChatSseProgressOut.description: SSE ``event: progress`` while UGS is processing the chat turn.

MarketingChatSseResultOut.title: MarketingChatSseResultOut
MarketingChatSseResultOut.description: SSE ``event: result`` with assistant message and AI run row.

rag_project_only.title: Rag Project Only
rag_project_only.description: Research uses project PG+RAG vault only; file/URL/brief not required.

ReadinessBreakdownOut.title: ReadinessBreakdownOut
ReadinessBreakdownOut.description: Компоненты 0–100 для расшифровки readiness_score (без дублирования формулы на клиенте).

weights.title: Weights
weights.description: Веса компонентов (strategy_base, operations, …) — см. READINESS_WEIGHTS на API.

contribution_points.title: Contribution Points
contribution_points.description: Приблизительный вклад каждого компонента в итоговый readiness_score (последний ключ поглощает округление).

coverage_average_rows_used.title: Coverage Average Rows Used
coverage_average_rows_used.description: Сколько строк coverage с total>0 участвовали в среднем для компонента «coverage».

coverage_average_slots_total.title: Coverage Average Slots Total
coverage_average_slots_total.description: Число строк в блоке coverage (слотов метрик связей).

ReadinessMetaOut.title: ReadinessMetaOut
ReadinessMetaOut.description: Веса readiness, вклад баллов по компонентам и прозрачность среднего по coverage.

filtered_total.title: Filtered Total
filtered_total.description: Rows matching filters/sort before maxItems cap (list widgets).
